JAPA 321.d: This course explores the language and culture of Japanese business communication. Students practice oral and written skills through role-plays, correspondence, presentations, and etiquette training. Emphasis is placed on authentic professional scenarios to build practical proficiency for effective communication in Japanese business contexts.
JAPA 321.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.
